instruction: In the calendar spreadsheet, highlight all Fridays by setting the cell background to purple (#800080). Ensure no other cells are modified.

metadata.explanation: Task variation 8: Highlight Fridays in purple. Expected to highlight 22 cells with color #800080. Verified by analyzing complete calendar data from cache file.
